events.title: DC Wine & Food Festival: night market
events.venue: Dock 5 and Plaza at Union Market
events.priceLabel: Free plaza entry; food extra; Wine Fest Preview $45
events.description: A one-night plaza market pairs restaurant collaborations with a separately ticketed wine preview inside Dock 5. Walk up for pay-as-you-go food or reserve the tasting component; valid ID is required.

events.title: DC Wine Fest: Fall Edition
events.time: Two sessions; Check source for times
events.description: Taste from the festival’s winery and spirits lineup at Union Market. Saturday has two ticketed sessions, so choose the session that fits your plans and confirm its entry time before going.

events.title: Turkish Festival
events.address: Pennsylvania Avenue NW between 3rd and 6th Streets, Washington, DC
events.priceLabel: Free admission; food and shopping extra
events.description: Turkish music, folk dancing, food, crafts and children’s activities fill Pennsylvania Avenue. Explore the bazaar, stop at the coffeehouse and make time for the stage program.
events.sourceName: American Turkish Association of Washington, DC

events.title: Centreville Day
events.venue: Historic Centreville Park and Historic District
events.priceLabel: Free admission, parking and children’s attractions
events.description: The historic district hosts a parade, live entertainment, a marketplace, history activities and a children’s trick-or-treat trail. Use the free off-site parking and shuttles, since festival streets close to traffic.

events.title: Butler’s Orchard Pumpkin Festival
events.description: Hayrides, giant slides, farm animals and a corn maze make a seasonal family outing. October 16 has special earlier opening hours. Pumpkins cost extra; reserve before driving because walk-ins depend on remaining capacity.

events.title: Butler’s Orchard Pumpkin Festival
events.description: Take a hayride, explore the corn maze and enjoy giant slides and barnyard animals. Peak-weekend tickets are best reserved in advance; pumpkins and some optional activities cost extra.

events.title: Great Country Farms Fall Pumpkin Harvest
events.time: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; last picking wagon 4:00 PM
events.priceLabel: $16 adult/$14 child online + $1 fee; pumpkins extra
events.description: Weekend farm activities add pig races, cider-press demonstrations, marshmallow roasting and P-Rex to pumpkin picking and the corn maze. Live music features Gary Hoffman Trio Saturday and Vagabonds Sunday.

events.description: The Seattle-based comedian with DC roots makes a Cellar Loft debut, bringing observational humor and energetic storytelling. Seating is first come, first served, with a two-item minimum in the showroom.

events.title: 18th Annual American Indian Festival
events.address: 16000 Croom Airport Road, Upper Marlboro, MD 20772
events.priceLabel: Free; food and artisan purchases extra
events.description: Experience Native American music, traditional and contemporary dance, storytelling and horsemanship. The festival also offers hands-on arts, demonstrations, an artisan market and Native food vendors.
events.sourceName: Prince George’s County Parks and Recreation

events.title: International Archaeology Family Day
events.address: 11410 Old Georgetown Road, North Bethesda, MD 20852
events.description: Try ceramic mending and marble making, then learn how archaeology reveals the lives of Josiah Henson and others at the former Riley Plantation. Tours run at 11 AM, 2 PM and 3:30 PM.

events.title: Little Jams: Jennifer Schimpf Trio
events.description: The Annapolis singer-songwriter closes the fall Little Jams series with a family-friendly morning concert. Bring a blanket or lawn chair, snacks and water; there are no food vendors on site.

events.title: Riversdale Harvest Fest
events.description: Join a relaxed harvest celebration with seed-saving activities, story time and a family scavenger hunt. The historic site’s gardener shares practical seasonal knowledge, with small prizes for scavenger-hunt participants.
events.sourceName: Prince George’s County Parks and Recreation

events.title: Pretty Bitter with Pulses., Padfoot and Thisdogllhunt
events.time: Doors 7:00 PM; Check source for set time
events.description: DC’s Pretty Bitter tops a four-band bill mixing pop-rock energy with the local DIY scene. The venue is a short walk from U Street Metro; confirm tickets and set times before going.

events.title: Guitar Hero Flashband Showcase
events.time: Doors 7:00 PM; Check source for set time
events.description: Eight newly formed bands tackle a rock-nostalgia setlist spanning classic guitar heroes and alternative favorites. The venue is a short walk from U Street Metro; confirm tickets and set times before going.

events.title: AJJ with Greet Death
events.time: Doors 7:30 PM; Check source for set time
events.description: AJJ brings its darkly comic, emotionally direct songwriting to Black Cat with Greet Death opening. The venue is a short walk from U Street Metro; confirm tickets and set times before going.

events.title: Sarau de Samba: Brazilian Samba Gathering
events.venue: Glen Echo Park, Ballroom Back Room
events.description: Musicians and dancers invite everyone to join Brazilian samba rhythms, from classics to carnival music. Short beginner lessons are included, and you can dance, sing or try instruments without bringing a partner.

events.title: Waltz Time with Callithump
events.description: Start with a waltz lesson, then dance to live music from Callithump’s guitar, accordion and fiddle. The historic Spanish Ballroom provides an atmospheric afternoon setting for social dancing.

events.title: The Big Build
events.description: Build alongside architects, artisans and tradespeople at a hands-on festival. Try mosaics, woodworking, concrete and building challenges; older children can explore digital experiences and the returning Adventure Yard.
